query: SELECT to_jsonb(c)::text AS clip, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM twitch_clips_upload_queue q WHERE q.clip_id = c.id AND q.status = 'pending'), 0) AS "pending_uploads!" FROM twitch_clips_social_media c WHERE ($1::text IS NULL OR LOWER(c.streamer_login) = LOWER($1)) AND ($2::text IS NULL OR c.status = $2) ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT $3
